summary: The fund normally invests substantially all of its assets in equity securities comprising the Solactive GBS Emerging Markets Large & Mid Cap USD Index NTR, depositary receipts based on securities comprising the index, ETFs providing exposure to such securities, and derivatives with economic characteristics similar to such securities or the index. The index is a free float market capitalization weighted index designed to measure the performance of emerging market large- and mid-capitalization companies. It is non-diversified.
